description: Predicts customers with a higher likelihood of leaving OrbitTel services and supports retention prioritisation.
data_inputs: Customer usage patterns; subscription history; service plan; interaction history
outputs: Churn probability score; customer risk segment; retention prioritisation list
eu_ai_act_risk_tier: Minimal Risk / Not identified as High-Risk
notes: Used for retention prioritisation. Current documented purpose does not include automated service termination, eligibility decisions, or pricing decisions. Reassess classification if the system is used to determine access to or materially restrict telecom services.

description: Generates response suggestions and retrieves approved information to assist customer service agents handling customer inquiries.
primary_purpose: Assist customer service agents with customer inquiries and response drafting
data_inputs: Customer interaction history; service information; product documentation; approved knowledge articles
outputs: AI-generated response suggestions; retrieved information; recommended next response
eu_ai_act_risk_tier: Minimal Risk / Article 50 applicability depends on deployment context
notes: Human agents remain responsible for customer-facing responses. Governance focus includes accuracy, hallucination controls, customer information protection, transparency, logging, and human review. If the AI directly communicates with customers, Article 50(1) transparency requirements should be assessed.

description: Predicts potential fiber network faults before they affect service and supports proactive maintenance planning.
primary_purpose: Proactive network fault identification and maintenance planning
data_inputs: Network telemetry; performance data; historical fault records; maintenance records
outputs: Fault probability; predicted fault alerts; affected network element list
eu_ai_act_risk_tier: Minimal Risk / Not identified as High-Risk
notes: Operational decision-support system. It does not make decisions about individuals. Governance focus includes model performance, false positives and negatives, data quality, reliability, monitoring, and human review of maintenance actions.

description: Identifies unusual usage patterns that may indicate misuse or fraud and prioritises cases for investigation.
data_inputs: Usage records; transaction data; subscription information; behavioural patterns
outputs: Fraud risk score; anomaly alerts; investigation queue
eu_ai_act_risk_tier: Minimal Risk / Not identified as High-Risk
notes: System identifies cases for investigation and should not autonomously conclude fraud or impose adverse customer action. Human investigation is required before consequential action. Governance focus includes false positives and negatives, fairness, explainability, data protection, evidence, and escalation.

description: Forecasts future network capacity requirements to support network investment and capacity planning.
data_inputs: Historical network traffic; capacity utilisation; subscriber growth; geographic demand patterns
outputs: Traffic forecasts; capacity projections; capacity risk alerts; planning scenarios
eu_ai_act_risk_tier: Minimal Risk / Not identified as High-Risk
notes: Pilot system supporting network planning. Governance focus includes forecast accuracy, scenario reliability, data quality, continuity, model monitoring, and human review. Go-live date represents pilot start. Dates are simulated for this case study.
